tools.name: obs-list-toolsets
tools.title: List Tool Groups
tools.description: List the groups of OBS tools, what each covers, and how many of its tools are enabled. Enable a group with obs-enable-toolset before using its tools

tools.name: obs-enable-toolset
tools.title: Enable Tool Groups
tools.description: Turn on groups of OBS tools for this session; the client reloads its tool list. See obs-list-toolsets

tools.name: obs-disable-toolset
tools.title: Disable Tool Groups
tools.description: Turn off groups of OBS tools for this session to keep the tool list short
